heading: Haridwar — where the plains meet the foothills
subheading: A city of pilgrimage, industry, and growing connectivity.
body: Haridwar sits on the banks of the Ganges at the point where the river enters the plains. As the traditional gateway to the Char Dham circuit, it has always drawn people — and today it is equally defined by the SIDCUL industrial estate, expanding infrastructure, and a steady stream of new residents.

The city connects by NH 34 toward Delhi and Dehradun, by rail from Haridwar Junction, and by air via Jolly Grant Airport near Dehradun. For homebuyers and investors, that mix of spiritual identity and practical connectivity is what makes Haridwar different from a typical tier-2 market.
